facts.text: Melanie expressed that family is super important to her, especially after an accident, and she is thankful to have them.

evidence.quote: Family's super important to me. Especially after the accident, I've thought a lot about how much I need them. They mean the world to me and I'm so thankful to have them.
I was really scared when we got into the accident. Thankfully, my son's ok and that was a reminder that life is precious and to cherish our family.

facts.text: Melanie mentioned that the children were scared during the accident but were reassured and explained that their brother would be OK.
